content.name: Sam Okafor
content.title: Backend engineer · Manchester
content.bio: Four years on payment infrastructure. I like queues I can reason about and migrations I can roll back.

items.title: Settlement engine
items.problem: Nightly settlement ran for six hours and could not be restarted after a failure without double-paying merchants.
items.solution: Rewrote it as idempotent, resumable batches keyed on a settlement id, with a replay tool for operators.
items.impact: Six hours to fifty minutes, and the first restart-without-fear in the team's history.
items.role: I designed the idempotency scheme and wrote the replay tool; a colleague owned the ledger schema.

items.title: Webhook relay
items.problem: Merchant webhooks were delivered once, from the request path, so a slow endpoint slowed our checkout.
items.solution: Moved delivery behind a queue with exponential backoff and a per-merchant circuit breaker.
items.impact: Checkout p95 down 340ms; delivery success up from 91% to 99.6%.
items.role: I built the relay end to end and ran the migration merchant by merchant.

items.title: Ledger audit trail
items.problem: Finance reconciled two systems by hand each month and found discrepancies weeks after they happened.
items.solution: Append-only audit log with a daily reconciliation job that reports drift the morning it appears.
items.impact: Discrepancy detection went from ~3 weeks to under 24 hours.
items.role: I owned the append-only schema and the reconciliation job.
